presentation.name: Shared link and button typography
presentation.statement: Links and buttons use font weight 600. Links have no underline in normal, hover or focus states; visible keyboard focus remains. Shared inline drawer actions use the configured MUI Link component. These are global presentation defaults, not Site-specific overrides. The global application theme owns the shared typography scale: PageTitle uses h3 at 1.5rem at every breakpoint, and application text has a minimum size of 0.875rem. Small controls, supporting text and Library tables inherit theme typography rather than local size literals. Current and completed breadcrumbs are the explicit weight-500 exception to normal link/button emphasis; future entries retain the default text weight. Library and Storybook display the same shared theme. Email typography and demonstration illustrations retain their separate presentation contracts.
